Poor communication and very customer unfriendly
Mar 2026 • Family
At 8.40 pm we were told that they are closed, however on website open until 9.30 pm.
Then we were allowed in anyway, but had to order before 9 pm. However, the waiter was first busy with other business, arrived at 20.58 with the card so when we ordered it was 21.02.
5 minutes after this the " receptionist" came to tell us that we had ordered late, so we were not given food.
Very poor communication amongst ourselves and scandalous how we have been treated. 
Very unhappy!!

Great vegetarian restaurant in HCM
Jul 2025 • Family
Great food and great service. Various vegetarian dishes: soups, noodles, pasta, fried dishes, sushi. A group of 10 ordered combo menus. The sushi was plated pretty and looked like real fish. The taste overall was great. A few of dishes of the menu were out of order, but there was still a lot to choose from, over 100 dishes. The service was on top, especially Minh Phuc. The atmosphere was cozy with lots of buddhism decorations.
